title: [review] tx_queue.rs:420: pop() returns expired ite
description: pop() does not call expire_before() or check is_expired(). If time advances between the last push() and a subsequent pop(), the returned item may have deadline_ms < now_ms (already expired). The caller must either call expire_before() before pop(), or check is_expired() on the returned item. This is likely intentional for performance but could surprise callers expecting only valid items.
